solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Top after card game is a strong position in which to be

definitions.text: a strong position in which to be

indicators.note: after places the word for top behind the card game

parts.note: bridge is a partnership card game
the head is the top of something

explanation.surface: A card player muses that the top seat after a game of cards is a commanding place to sit.
explanation.definitionFit: A military foothold seized in enemy territory is a secure, advantageous position from which to advance.

clue.text: Herb is a man's name

definitions.meaning: a sweet aromatic plant used in Italian cooking and pesto
a male first name, as in the actor Rathbone

explanation.surface: A quip that the culinary plant is also a fellow's name — the two senses of Herb.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a common kitchen plant and a traditional male forename.

clue.text: Fancy welcoming prostitute up to see an etching, perhaps?

indicators.note: welcoming means the first word takes the second inside it

parts.note: a fancy is a fanciful notion, an illusion

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: a tart is slang for a prostitute

explanation.surface: A seedy invitation for a streetwalker to come upstairs and view some artwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' looks like a verb inviting someone, but it is a noun. The question mark flags that an etching is just one example of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An etching is one kind of picture printed in a book or shown as artwork, hence an example.

clue.text: Colour — some meagre yellow

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Describing a colour as a little pale, thin yellow.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a shade between black and white, so a hue like any other.

clue.text: Strong dislike of headgear by cardinal?

parts.note: a hat is a piece of headgear
cardinal is a deep scarlet colour, after a cardinal's robes

explanation.surface: Asking whether a strong aversion to hats is shown by a churchman.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that 'cardinal' stands for a colour, not a prelate.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense loathing is exactly a strong aversion to someone or something.

clue.text: Main date turned out lively and passionate?

indicators.note: turned out means the letters of the two words are reshaped into something else

explanation.surface: Someone's chief date proved spirited and ardent.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirited, full of life and feeling: an excited, impassioned debate is described this way.

clue.text: Helpful new turnstile man

indicators.note: new tells us the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Praising the obliging fellow who has just started on the stadium turnstile.
explanation.definitionFit: Being instrumental in something means playing a useful, contributing part in bringing it about.

clue.text: Noah's craft almost, twice, located in this place

indicators.note: twice asks for the shortened boat to be written two times over
almost says the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: Noah built the ark to survive the Flood
at means located in, as in at home

explanation.surface: Noah's boat came to rest somewhere, and the clue asks you to find where.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims ARK to AR and 'twice' doubles it. The definition fits well, since the Ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount Ararat in Turkey is the traditional landing place of the Ark in Genesis, so it is the spot described.

clue.text: With sufficient means to settle books

parts.note: to settle a problem is to solve it
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Having enough money to pay off the accounts.
explanation.walkthrough: NT for the New Testament is a standard way to clue 'books'.
explanation.definitionFit: A solvent business or person can pay all debts, having the financial resources to do so.

clue.text: Victor not initially seen as spiritual

indicators.note: not initially says the opening letter of the word is lost

parts.note: a victor is the winner of a contest

explanation.surface: A champion who is not seen at first as a soulful person.
explanation.definitionFit: One's inner life is the mental or spiritual one, as opposed to the outward and physical.

clue.text: Endure explosion as the front's abandoned

indicators.note: the front being abandoned means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: a blast is an explosion

explanation.surface: Soldiers urged to hold out through a bombardment as their front line is given up.
explanation.definitionFit: To last is to continue or survive, as in holding out through hardship.

clue.text: Put off about tin as a drinks container

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the second

parts.note: to put off is to deter
a can is a tin

explanation.surface: Someone discouraged by a tin can used to serve drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoppered glass vessel into which wine or spirits are poured for serving.

clue.text: A very quiet fish is near

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler noting that a silent fish is close by.
explanation.definitionFit: To near something is to draw closer to it, the same verb as come towards.

clue.text: Bind with plaster areas getting knocked about

indicators.note: knocked about here means turned round, so the word is written back to front

parts.note: parts are areas or regions

explanation.surface: A medic bandaging regions of the body that have been bruised in a scuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: To tape up an injured limb with adhesive bandage, as in strapping a sprained ankle.

clue.text: Staff made to eat rook are very hungry

indicators.note: made to eat means the first word takes the second inside it

parts.note: a stave is a staff or stick
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: Workers forced to eat a crow because they are ravenous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' looks like employees, but it is a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: People who starve are famished, suffering severely for lack of food.

clue.text: Time perfect to return and burst

indicators.note: to return means the combined letters are read backwards

parts.note: pure means perfect, flawless

explanation.surface: The ideal moment to go back and break out.
explanation.definitionFit: A volcano bursting forth with lava, or anything breaking out suddenly.

clue.text: Weapon in a rug unfurled

indicators.note: unfurled suggests the letters are spread out into a new order

explanation.surface: A gun hidden rolled up in a carpet, revealed as it is laid out.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun firing pellets by compressed air is a type of firearm.

clue.text: A body-builder getting a heavenly body?

parts.note: anabolic steroids are taken to build muscle, so a steroid builds the body

explanation.surface: A gym fanatic acquiring a gorgeous physique.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heavenly body' looks like a compliment on physique; here it means something in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocky minor planet orbiting the Sun is literally a body in the heavens.

clue.text: One brave seen amongst Cherokees

indicators.note: seen amongst says the answer is visible inside the letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A single warrior spotted among a Native American people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brave' looks like a Native American warrior, fitting the Cherokees, but it means a courageous person.
explanation.definitionFit: A courageous person admired for bold deeds is the classic noun for someone brave.

clue.text: Whoever possesses depressant drug should be beheaded

indicators.note: beheaded means the first letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a downer is slang for a depressant drug

explanation.surface: A grim decree that anyone holding sedatives must be executed.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who has or holds title to something is by definition the one who possesses it.

clue.text: Explanations sounded very sensible

indicators.note: sounded signals that the word is spoken and its sound gives the entry

parts.note: the whys of something are the reasons or explanations for it

explanation.surface: Remarks that the explanations given seemed very reasonable.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing sound judgement and good sense, like a sage.

clue.text: Instrument in sextet and a fairly late trio of Nicolai

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals, a sextet

indicators.note: a fairly late trio means three letters near, but not at, the end of the name are taken

explanation.surface: A musical instrument played by a group of six, with a composer named Nicolai.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a fairly late trio of' keeps the fourth to sixth letters of Nicolai, OLA, dropping the opening three and the final I.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowed string instrument a little larger than the violin.

clue.text: Good tinsel appearing roughly to do this

definitions.text: Good tinsel appearing roughly to do this

indicators.note: roughly says the letters of the word appear in a rough, disordered form

explanation.surface: Good tinsel is meant to sparkle, and the clue asks what it does.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: 'this' points back to what good tinsel does.
explanation.definitionFit: Tinsel sparkles and shines, catching the light with a twinkling gleam.

clue.text: University head's opportunity, register having returned

parts.note: a chance is an opportunity

indicators.note: having returned means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a roll is a register of names

explanation.surface: A college principal's chance to see the student list come back.
explanation.definitionFit: British universities have a ceremonial titular head bearing this title.
